correctness.rationale: The positive quadratic Gauss sum for p≡1(mod4) gives H_E=(pI_4−J_4+√p S_E)/(p−1) for all four distinct frequencies. Rayleigh inequalities S_E≤3I and J≥0 give β=(p+3√p)/(p−1), with equality iff the signed graph is a balanced switching all-positive pattern whose top sign vector sums to zero, exactly induced 2K2. Similarly S_E≥−3I and J≤4I give γ=(p−4−3√p)/(p−1), equality iff four Paley-independent vertices. For p≥29, the common-neighbor size (p−5)/4 exceeds Hoffman α(Paley)≤√p, forcing a four-clique; nonsquare scaling provides a four-independent set. Common nonneighbors contain an edge forcing 2K2. For p=13,17, the packaged certificate enumerates all 715 and 2380 four-sets, reduces them to signed matrices, and uses exact rational square-root brackets and integer leading principal minors to isolate star minima at α_p; witnesses are explicit. The star two-by-two block gives α. For p=5 the two-row rank calculation gives spectrum (0,0,3/2,5/2). Algebraic comparison of edges then proves the δ4 transition. Independent local Gram eigenspectra enumerations at p=5,13,17,29,37 matched extrema; infinitely many primes use the analytic graph argument, not this enumeration.
